entries.question_fil: Ano ang ihahanda ng BHW para sa ligtas na trabaho?
entries.question_en: What should a BHW prepare for safe work?
entries.answer_fil: Suriin ang hazards, lokal na protocol, reporting contact at kinakailangang kagamitan/PPE. Iulat ang kulang at huwag ituloy ang hindi ligtas o lampas-sa-training na gawain.
entries.answer_en: Check hazards, local protocols, reporting contacts and necessary equipment/PPE. Report gaps and do not proceed with unsafe work or tasks beyond training.

entries.question_fil: Ano ang agarang gagawin kapag natusok ng ginamit na karayom sa trabaho?
entries.question_en: What immediate action follows a used-needle injury at work?
entries.answer_fil: Hugasan ng sabon at tubig, iulat agad sa supervisor at magpa-medical evaluation kaagad. Huwag hintayin ang sintomas o tapos ng duty; clinician ang magpapasya sa post-exposure care.
entries.answer_en: Wash with soap and water, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation. Do not wait for symptoms or shift end; a clinician decides post-exposure care.

entries.question_fil: Anong infection prevention ang kailangan sa BHS?
entries.question_en: What infection prevention is needed at the BHS?
entries.answer_fil: Sundin ang hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, bentilasyon, task-appropriate PPE at ligtas na waste handling ayon sa lokal na protocol. Hindi kapalit ng hand hygiene ang gloves.
entries.answer_en: Follow hand hygiene, respiratory hygiene, ventilation, task-appropriate PPE and safe waste handling under local protocols. Gloves do not replace hand hygiene.

entries.question_fil: Paano paghahandaan ang hazards sa household visit?
entries.question_en: How do I prepare for household-visit hazards?
entries.answer_fil: Suriin ang ruta, panahon, hayop at banta. Ipaalam ang lakad, magplano ng tubig/lilim/pahinga at alamin ang reporting contact. Humingi ng alternatibo kapag hindi ligtas ang pagbisita.
entries.answer_en: Check the route, weather, animals and threats. Share the itinerary, plan water/shade/rest and know the reporting contact. Seek an alternative when a visit is unsafe.

entries.question_fil: Paano haharapin ng BHW ang sobrang workload?
entries.question_en: How can a BHW respond to excessive workload?
entries.answer_fil: Ipaalam ang kapasidad at napagkasunduang oras sa coordinator. Humingi ng reprioritization, reassignment o pahinga. Iulat ang panganib; hindi kailangang tiisin ang sobrang pagod para patunayang may malasakit.
entries.answer_en: Tell the coordinator your capacity and agreed hours. Request reprioritization, reassignment or rest. Report risk; enduring exhaustion is not proof of caring.
